Interview Notice
Junior Research Fellow (JRF)
This is for the information of all candidates who have applied for the post of Junior Research
Fellow (JRF) in the JKSTIC-funded research project entitled "Artificial Intelligence-based Predictive
Irrigation Monitoring and Control System for Apple Orchards", notified vide notification No F-
(Project-JKSTIC-JRF-02)/KU Dated: 06-08-2026, that the interview has been scheduled as per the
following details:
• Date: Monday, 07-09-2026
• Time: 2:00 PM
• Venue: Office Chamber of the Head, Department of Electronics, University of
Kashmir, housed on the 2nd Floor of the Humanities Block.
All candidates are required to produce their original certificates, experience certificates,
Research papers (where applicable), and other relevant testimonials at the time of the interview
for on-the-spot verification.
No TA/DA shall be paid for appearing in the interview.
Sd/-
Prof. M. Tariq Banday
Principal Investigator
No F-(Project-JKSTIC-JRF-04)/KU Dated: 31-08-2026

• HOD, Department of Electronics, for the information and necessary arrangements;
